properties.name: cosky.store.type
properties.description: The store: redis, or memory for development, where nothing survives the process.

properties.name: cosky.store.redis.uri
properties.description: Redis URI, also a Sentinel one such as redis-sentinel://s1:26379,s2:26379#mymaster. A command waits at most 5 seconds for Redis, unless the URI sets its own timeout.

properties.name: cosky.store.redis.cluster
properties.description: Whether the URI is a seed of a Redis Cluster.

properties.name: cosky.store.redis.tail-poll-interval
properties.description: How often each namespace is read when no hint arrives. A number without a unit is in seconds.

properties.name: cosky.auth.enabled
properties.description: Whether calls need a token. Off, everyone may do everything: only for development.

properties.name: cosky.auth.bootstrap-token
properties.description: Token that becomes the admin ServiceAccount on the first start, COSKY_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN by default.

properties.name: cosky.auth.namespace-accounts
properties.description: Whether every namespace gets a ServiceAccount of its own name, bound to role client there, whose token its applications share.

properties.name: cosky.auth.oidc.issuer
properties.description: Issuer of the OIDC provider. Turns OIDC on, together with client-id.

properties.name: cosky.auth.oidc.client-id
properties.description: The Dashboard's OIDC client.

properties.name: cosky.auth.oidc.audience
properties.description: What a token must be for; the client when not set.

properties.name: cosky.auth.oidc.groups-claim
properties.description: The claim holding group names.

properties.name: cosky.auth.oidc.scopes
properties.description: Scopes the Dashboard asks for. Some providers send groups only when asked.

properties.name: cosky.watch.window
properties.description: Events kept for resuming, per namespace, and in the store's log. Should be at least the peak event rate times the longest reconnection gap.

properties.name: cosky.watch.window-bytes
properties.description: The same in bytes, per namespace, in memory and in the store's log.

properties.name: cosky.watch.progress-interval
properties.description: How often idle watches get a bookmark. A number without a unit is in seconds.

properties.name: cosky.watch.max-per-stream
properties.description: Watches allowed on one stream.

properties.name: cosky.watch.anti-entropy-interval
properties.description: How often a replica compares its view with the store. A number without a unit is in seconds.

properties.name: cosky.read.min-revision-timeout
properties.description: How long a read or a resume waits for a replica to catch up. A number without a unit is in seconds.

properties.name: cosky.view.topology-flush-interval
properties.description: How often a replica records who watches whom. Edges expire after three times this. A number without a unit is in seconds.

properties.name: cosky.lease.reaper-interval
properties.description: How often expired leases are looked for. A number without a unit is in seconds.

properties.name: cosky.lease.reaper-grace
properties.description: No reaping for this long after becoming leader, or after failing to reach the store. A number without a unit is in seconds.

properties.name: cosky.lease.reaper-max-per-tick
properties.description: Leases reaped per namespace per round.

properties.name: cosky.lease.lock-ttl
properties.description: How long the reaper's leadership lasts without renewal. A number without a unit is in seconds.

properties.name: cosky.lease.protection-threshold
properties.description: Reaping pauses when more than this share of a namespace's leases expire at once.

properties.name: cosky.lease.protection-min-leases
properties.description: Namespaces with fewer leases have no such pause.

properties.name: cosky.lease.protection-max-duration
properties.description: How long such a pause lasts at most. A number without a unit is in seconds.

values.description: In memory, for development: nothing survives the process.
